from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u063/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            min_r = min(y for y, x in cells)
            max_r = max(y for y, x in cells)
            min_c = min(x for y, x in cells)
            max_c = max(x for y, x in cells)
            components.append({
                "color": color,
                "cells": [(y-min_r, x-min_c) for y, x in cells],
                "height": max_r-min_r+1,
                "width": max_c-min_c+1,
                "size": len(cells),
                "left": min_c,
            })
    colors = sorted({obj["color"] for obj in components}, key=lambda color: min(o["left"] for o in components if o["color"] == color))
    by_color = {color: sorted((o for o in components if o["color"] == color), key=lambda o: o["size"]) for color in colors}
    left, right = colors
    left_objs, right_objs = by_color[left], by_color[right]
    bottom_height = max(left_objs[1]["height"], right_objs[1]["height"])
    bottom_top = rows - bottom_height
    upper_baseline = bottom_top - 2
    right_col = max(o["width"] for o in left_objs) + 1
    out = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    for obj, anchor, baseline in (
        (left_objs[0], 0, upper_baseline),
        (right_objs[0], right_col, upper_baseline),
        (left_objs[1], 0, rows-1),
        (right_objs[1], right_col, rows-1),
    ):
        top = baseline - obj["height"] + 1
        for dy, dx in obj["cells"]:
            out[top+dy][anchor+dx] = obj["color"]
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-0835cf6a.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path, path.exists())
